derivation: Descriptive scope judgments after the preregistered measurements; not additional preregistered hypothesis tests. Raw metrics.json preserved unchanged.

packages.measured_scope: Causal recurrent/cache contract and matched-information no-feedback control pass numerical and oracle-gradient checks.
packages.boundary: Independent tiny implementation; no production state manager or official checkpoint reproduction.

packages.measured_scope: Finite long-horizon accuracy is strong, but task/seed-dependent errors occur; per-seed 1024-token values below.
packages.boundary: Tests stop at1024 consumed tokens; no infinite-depth or arbitrary-task claim.

packages.measured_scope: Extra neutral tokens do not establish a useful-computation benefit; five-state cases degrade while consuming additional measured time.
packages.boundary: Token-clock recurrence with k=0; not the separate title-refinement mechanism.

packages.measured_scope: Dense-prefix learning succeeds; final-target-only full and TBPTT models remain near chance. Checkpoint gradient/update equivalence holds, without observed whole-process peak-memory saving.
packages.boundary: TBPTT cuts recurrent output/decoder KV only; global encoder routes remain. Whole-process memory is not activation-only allocation.

packages.measured_scope: Widths32 and48 were actually trained/evaluated on parity; these two tiny widths do not establish a scaling law or a width advantage.
packages.boundary: Core-width portion only; external module covers other package14 scopes. Energy, RL, large-model and unrestricted-language scaling unmeasured.
